eis_specs.document_title: Moorabool Wind Farm — MP-permit source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.notes: Regime: MP-permit. Approved by Vic Planning Minister Oct 2010 under Planning and Environment Act 1987 (permit amended 2016/2018/2020 to allow larger WTGs). Developed by Westwind Energy, sold to Goldwind Australia Sep 2016. Fully commissioned 2022; 305 MW registered, 321 MW nameplate. Split into North + South entities.
